format_label_tensor: convert numpy arrays, sequences, or integers to a 1D PyTorch label tensor
format_score_tensor: convert numpy arrays, sequences, or tensors to a 1D PyTorch float score tensor
cat_batch_labels: concatenate a list of label tensors into one tensor with split indices
batch_label_to_onehot: convert a concatenated batch label tensor to one-hot format using split indices
label_to_onehot: convert a single label value to a one-hot encoded tensor for a given number of classes
